        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax_bucket3,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt_bucket4,
